minutes.headline: Planning Board worked through a draft medical marijuana bylaw; public hearing set for March 24 after legal review.
minutes.summary: Most of the meeting went to the draft medical marijuana (RMD) bylaw: buffer strips and setbacks, security and an armed guard idea, lighting and design standards. The board approved the 419 Sunny Hill Road plan, the Feb 24 minutes and executive minutes, and backed a Whitetail Crossing warrant placeholder. Members and a selectman also raised concerns about an earth removal ruling for the Elmwood subdivision and about sight distance at a commercial driveway.

public_comment.topic: A selectman invited the board to a workshop before the public hearing on the bylaw and drainage costs for subdivisions.

votes.motion: Approve the plan for 419 Sunny Hill Road (ANR).
Approve the regular meeting minutes of February 24, 2014.
Accept the executive session minutes as submitted.
Approve the memo supporting a placeholder on the warrant for Whitetail Crossing, conditional on peer review by Jesse and Jack.
Go into executive session, not to return, on litigation strategy (O'Brien Homes v. Town of Lunenburg).

budget_items.what_was_said: A selectman worried about the town cost of drainage projects on subdivisions and the strain on DPW, especially with a new school.
The planning staff will ask the Finance Committee for a land use director position in the budget.

decisions.decision: Staff will fix the bylaw draft per tonight's comments and send it to town counsel for review before the March 24 public hearing.
Board will ask the police chief about the armed guard idea and invite both chiefs to the public hearing.
Elmwood Road subdivision endorsement was extended to March 24 at the applicant's request.
Staff will ask the highway superintendent about posting speed signage near the commercial driveway.
Next meetings set: public hearing March 24, then April 14 and April 20.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board spent most of the meeting on a draft medical marijuana bylaw and sent it to town counsel ahead of a March 24 public hearing.
The board voted to approve the plan for 419 Sunny Hill Road, an approval-not-required (ANR) plan.
The board approved a memo supporting a warrant placeholder for Whitetail Crossing, conditional on peer review.
The Elmwood Road subdivision endorsement was extended to March 24 at the applicant's request.
A selectman raised the town cost of subdivision drainage and invited the board to a workshop before the hearing.

why_it_matters: The marijuana bylaw would set where a dispensary can be sited and what security, lighting and design it must have, and residents may be asked to vote on it at Town Meeting.
Drainage work on subdivisions can land on the town budget, mostly taxes, and on the public works department, so how the board handles it can affect future costs.
watch_next: Public hearing on the medical marijuana bylaw on March 24, after town counsel reviews the revised draft.
Whether the Finance Committee takes up the request for a land use director position in the budget.
